content.intro: Learn Mutability, Copying, and Freezing Objects through a visual model, a minimal Ruby example, and a practical check.
content.why_it_matters: Understanding mutability, copying, and freezing objects helps you write code that is easier to explain, test, and maintain. It also helps separate Ruby language guarantees from runtime assumptions, dependency behavior, and application-specific rules.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Mutability, Copying, and Freezing Objects helps you reason about mutable versus immutable-style values. In Ruby, prefer a small example whose inputs and expected result are easy to explain. This lesson connects the syllabus topic to practical code and highlights where assumptions or edge cases matter.

content_blocks.title: How to think about it
content_blocks.text: Begin by identifying the key rule: Mutable versus immutable-style values. Then connect it to Shallow copies and shared references. The remaining syllabus points—dup , clone , and freeze, Frozen containers and the objects they contain—are useful checks before applying this in a larger project.
